response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced full-stack/backend developer with a strong track record across web, mobile, and systems programming, but his core expertise is in TypeScript, Node.js, JavaScript, and DLang rather than C++. His only substantial C++ experience was a brief stint (Dec 2014–Jun 2015) writing C/C++ components for an IDE, far short of the 8-12 years of dedicated C++/STL development this role requires. There is no evidence of MQTT, IEC 62443, industrial cybersecurity, message brokers, or industrial protocol experience.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience
Strong background in testing, TDD, CI/CD, and software craftsmanship practices
Experience with distributed systems, async I/O, and performance-sensitive backend work (DLang at Sociomantic)
concerns: Minimal recent C++ experience (~6 months, over a decade ago) against a role requiring deep C++/STL mastery
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity experience
No mention of MQTT, REST-based IoT systems, message brokers, or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.)

key_factors.factor: No IoT/MQTT/message broker or industrial protocol experience
